701:t_003:5.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「We understand the principle of coexistence! That is precisely why we gained power and obtained eternity like this!」

701:t_003:6.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「And we joined hands with $$皇帝ズール$$ and the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, who became gods just as we did! We stand with the truth!」

701:t_003:9.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「You have no right to speak, when all you've done is barely reach the entrance to $$シンカ$$!」

701:t_003:10.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「That is exactly what you fail to understand, you fools!」

701:t_004:0.en:
$$タケル$$
「...The ones we have to defeat first are the $$御使い$$s... I thought that if we shared the same goal, we could cooperate, if only for a while, but...」

701:t_004:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「If that's how you want it, we won't hesitate to fight!」

701:t_004:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「$$ミケーネ$$! And the army of darkness! We'll show you our new power!」

701:t_004:4.en:
$$ミケーネ神$$
「They're different! From these people we've fought until now!」

701:t_004:6.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Precisely. They have grasped the truth, and learned the art of becoming one with their machines...」

701:t_004:7.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Its name... $$真化融合$$! Savor that power well!」

701:t_004:8.en:
$$甲児$$
「Let's go, $$ミケーネ$$! Today I'm going to beat that arrogance of yours into the ground once and for all!」

701:t_004:9.en:
$$タケル$$
「And know this! The strength of our resolve and determination!!」

701:t_005:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Destruction of $$ミケーネ$$ and the army of darkness confirmed.」

701:t_005:1.en:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The power of $$真化融合$$... It's formidable.」

701:t_005:2.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Indeed... Even though it's our own power, it's almost frightening.」

701:t_005:3.en:
$$葵$$
「But this isn't the end, is it...」

701:t_005:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Someone has been watching our battle from the shadows.」

701:t_006:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I had concealed my presence, though.」

701:t_006:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Ever since we came to this universe, our senses seem to have become sharper.」

701:t_006:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Is it because you've advanced along the path to $$シンカ$$?」

701:t_006:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And I got to see it. Your new power... $$真化融合$$...」

701:t_006:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll say it again, $$ヴィルダーク$$. If you acknowledge our strength, we want you to lend us a hand in overthrowing the $$御使い$$s.」

701:t_006:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That... I cannot do.」

701:t_006:8.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This is the answer.」

701:t_007:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「So you've brought out the $$次元獣$$s!」

701:t_007:1.en:
$$赤木$$
「What do you mean, this is the answer!?」

701:t_007:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$真化融合$$... That theory was being proposed in the world we came from, too.」

701:t_007:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But a theory is only a theory... We were unable to reach that state.」

701:t_007:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「What was developed as a substitute for it is the $$リヴァイヴ・セル$$.」

701:t_007:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「The substance that creates $$次元獣$$s...!」

701:t_007:7.en:
$$スザク$$
「A $$次元獣$$ forcibly fuses man and machine, and draws out an even greater power through $$次元力$$...」

701:t_007:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「So that, too, is a sort of pseudo-$$真化融合$$.」

701:t_007:9.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Your existence is the fruition of our world's unfulfilled dream.」

701:t_007:10.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「At the same time, it means denying everything we have done... the entire army of $$次元獣$$s.」

701:t_007:11.en:
$$桂$$
「So that's why you can't accept that we exist.」

701:t_007:12.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「'Irreconcilable' would be the better word.」

701:t_007:13.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If I were to acknowledge you, I would be defiling every life we have taken until now to turn into $$次元獣$$s.」

701:t_007:15.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「...I knew. That our way of doing things was wrong.」

701:t_007:16.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$次元獣ヴァルナー$$ that never reaches its final form... This must be proof of my hesitation.」

701:t_007:17.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Even so, I had no choice but to go through with it... I kept telling myself there was no other way. But it was all meaningless.」

701:t_007:18.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「All I can do, to repay their lives, is defeat you with this power...!」

701:t_007:19.en:
$$ランド$$
「So you really do mean to fight!」

701:t_007:20.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Now that I think of it, I have fought up to this day by forcing others to sacrifice...」

701:t_007:21.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ soldiers who were made to fight on orders, without even being told the circumstances...」

701:t_007:22.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$エルーナルーナ$$, who wished for revenge for her father's life and the freedom of the $$ハイアデス$$ taken from her...」

701:t_007:23.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$尸空#pilot$$, who sought to strike down anyone who perverted his clan's mission...」

701:t_007:24.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$バルビエル$$, who swore obedience to them and warped his hatred, though all his kin had been destroyed...」

701:t_007:25.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「$$ガドライト#pilot$$, who was ashamed of drifting between anger and resignation, and regained the will and pride to live again...」

701:t_007:26.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「And the Reactor of the $$立ち上がる射手$$ who came before me, who challenged the $$御使い$$s with indomitable fighting spirit...」

701:t_007:27.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「By taking their lives, I gained the power of four $$スフィア$$s.」

701:t_007:28.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That is why I must fight...! And I must win!」

701:t_007:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「A man who lost sight of what he should be doing for the sake of self-satisfaction... What a pitiful sight.」

701:t_007:32.en:
$$刹那$$
「If you knew that what you were doing was a mistake, why didn't you try to change yourself!」

701:t_007:33.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't refuse to change! Not when there's a better way!」

701:t_007:34.en:
$$タケル$$
「Your greatest mistake is your arrogance, your refusal to change how you live!」

701:t_007:35.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Say what you will. This is all I am capable of.」

701:t_007:37.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then I'll take you on! In whatever way satisfies you!」

701:t_007:38.en:
$$アマタ$$
「We can't afford to lose either!」

701:t_007:39.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Be careful! He's far stronger than when we fought at $$ラース・バビロン$$!」

701:t_007:40.en:
$$シャア$$
「So he's become able to draw out the power of four $$スフィア$$s too!」

701:t_007:41.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But it's still not enough! To defeat the fundamental calamity... the future of despair... the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_007:42.en:
$n
「Just as you can't accept our existence, we can't accept you, who have made Earth suffer!」

701:t_007:43.en:
$n
「I won't let a power like that open up the future!」

701:t_007:44.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then come, warriors of Earth! The victor earns the right to challenge the $$御使い$$s!」

701:t_007:45.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Once I've beaten you, I will gain the power to kill a god!!」

701:t_008:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「This is as far as I go...!」

701:t_008:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Needless to say... The victors are you...」

kept_omissions: 701:t_007:24: who destroyed Barbiel's kin is left implicit (passive, as in the Japanese); the 'them' he swore obedience to (奴等) is taken to be the Sidereal
701:t_007:27: 奴等 = 'their lives' rendered 'them', referring to the people listed in rows 21-26
uncertain: 701:t_003:4-10 / t_004:6-7: Zeus is read as scolding the other Mycenaean gods (not the heroes); 'That is exactly what you fail to understand' (t_003:10) and 'Savor that power well' (t_004:7) are addressed to the gods, 'they' in t_004:6 = the Earth forces
701:t_007:26: 俺の前の立ち上がる射手のリアクター read as 'the Standing Archer Reactor before me' (previous holder)
701:t_007:24: 奴等 for Barbiel read as the Sidereal
701:t_006:0-1: Vildark's hidden presence / Kamille 'we can tell now' - 俺達 rendered 'we'
701:t_007:36: 生真面目すぎる rendered 'too damn serious, pal' (pal added for Kei's voice)
701:t_003:9: 真化 alone = $$シンカ$$ token ('entrance to Shinka')
